description: This file contains React components and utility functions related to emoji handling and avatar display within a chat application interface. It includes components for emoji picking, avatar rendering based on model type, and URL generation for emoji images.

methods.name: getEmojiUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for an emoji image based on its unified code and style, using a CDN.

methods.name: AvatarPicker
methods.description: A React component that renders an emoji picker widget with customizable emoji selection callback.

methods.name: Avatar
methods.description: A React component that displays a user avatar which is either a bot icon or an emoji avatar based on props.

methods.name: EmojiAvatar
methods.description: A React component that shows an emoji image using the unified emoji code.
